pending_virtual_orders_exist.meaning: TWAMM pool has pending virtual orders that lockAndExecuteVirtualOrders will execute during the deposit's lock callback

sqrt_ratio_updated_by_orders.meaning: executing pending virtual orders updates sqrtRatio so pool state can change between the pre-lock slippage check and deposit processing
sqrt_ratio_updated_by_orders.checkpoint: during deposit lock callback after virtual order execution

user_supplies_max_amounts.meaning: user supplies maxAmount0/maxAmount1 as slippage limits for the deposit

spent_exceeds_max_amounts.meaning: amounts actually spent by the deposit exceed the user-supplied maxAmount0/maxAmount1 slippage limits after sqrtRatio update from executing pending virtual orders

assumptions: The deposit is processed after pending virtual orders execute and update sqrtRatio.
The overspend is described as affecting the depositing user.
Pending virtual orders are conditionally present, not guaranteed.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric values for maxAmount0/maxAmount1, sqrtRatio change, or spent amounts, so the bound is represented as a grounded Boolean relation rather than a numeric comparison.
Report does not specify whether pending virtual orders are always present or only conditionally, beyond conditional phrasing.

limitations: Impact modality is potential; the relation forbids the overspend scenario but does not assert it is inevitable.
Numeric slippage bounds are not provided; later code binding must supply concrete maxAmount and spent-amount quantities.
